meta.format: RGBA8888 (Pillow, indexed .q.png copy alongside (pngquant 3.0.3) on the box)

packing.note: Untrimmed grid: one row per animation, 2 px gutter, frame = sourceSize, pivot at the anchor.

pivot.note: pivot (150, 150) = target centre on the ground

body.note: like cartoon.js: body radius = hitbox x drawScale; art normalised so its inner life-ring outer radius = 75 px = body r (= the danger radius dangerR = tower.radius + hitRadius the game passes); the new outer hazard ring reaches 1.83x that (about 137 px)

memory.note: bytes once decoded to RGBA8888 (w * h * 4)

meta.notBakedIn: no squash/stretch, hit flash, low-HP tint, rotation or ground shadow (the code draws those)
meta.license: Original art generated for Brian Awsumb's Last Stand Tower with Grok Bot GenerateImage; no third-party packs. Style reference: Brian's own enemy sprites.
meta.role: ground target warning where a coconut will land; draw under enemies
meta.scaleRule: game draws it with bodyR = dangerR (tower radius 26 + hitRadius 18 = 44 world units): inner ring edge at 44 u, outer hazard ring band from ~64 to ~80 u, i.e. 40-51 CSS px from the target centre at 390x844, outside the ~27 CSS px tower art
meta.v012: wider outer ring so a shot aimed at the tower still shows a clear warning ring around the tower (v0.1.1 showed only an ~11 px rim)

provenance.postProcess: _tools/keying.py + _tools/sheet.py (key, un-mix, cut grid cells, scale per source sheet, register on anchor, atlas)

quantizedCopy.metric: PSNR / max error on premultiplied RGBA (colour under alpha 0 ignored)
quantizedCopy.note: same layout as the RGBA original; use either (the RGBA original stays the master)

originalImage.name: coconut_warning_decal.png
originalImage.note: RGBA master from the delivery; the repo ships the pngquant copy above (see ../PROVENANCE.json)
